name: Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic (1940–1953)
description: A red field with the initials 'ENSV' in yellow letters in the upper hoist above a yellow hammer and sickle.
history: First flag of the Estonian SSR, adopted on 27 July 1940 after the Soviet occupation and annexation of Estonia: a red banner with the initials of 'Eesti Nõukogude Sotsialistlik Vabariik' and the hammer and sickle. It was replaced on 6 February 1953 by the flag with blue and white waves.
